name: DML - Dynamic Mission Library
summary: Mission-building toolbox whose modules are configured through Mission Editor trigger-zone attributes, no Lua needed.
description: Modules are loaded inside a mission and read attributes placed on trigger zones (spawners, cloners, CSAR, civil traffic, persistence and more). Ships with a PDF manual and demo missions. The repository is marked discontinued.

releases.changelog: Build 20250717 per forum thread; repo later marked discontinued (last commit 2026-06-04).
